description.value: Mi Tierra Latina is a Latin American grocery store stocking products from nine countries including Mexico, Colombia, Brazil, Peru, and El Salvador. The store carries an unusually broad range of specialty items — tortillas, chiles, frozen empanadas, Latin coffees, and regional snacks — making it a standout source of authentic ingredients on Commercial Drive. Cyclists exploring Vancouver's diverse east-side food scene would find it a compelling stop for culturally specific pantry staples.
